text: You copied a fucking DM script off YouTube, right?
style: Cheeky and mocking, quick, like a best friend about to roast you.

text: Free PDF, some guy with a Lambo. I paste it to every lead.
style: Proud and casual, a laid-back American guy at the pool, showing off his shortcut to his buddy.

text: Your lead got that exact message from every guy who watched that video.
style: A mocking roast, slow and smug, savoring the end.

text: They ask how much, I send my call link.
style: Defensive and a bit annoyed, shrugging it off.
Flat and deadpan, a trap question.

text: Seen. Or "I'll think about it," so I pitch again.
style: Deflated, a beat after the first word, then rushing through the rest like a confession.
Teasing and mocking, a short pause before the last two words.

text: Okay genius, what do I send?
style: Annoyed but curious, half laughing, giving in.

text: Answer what they asked. One question at a time. Check the fit, offer two times. "I'll think about it"? Ask which part.
style: Calm and confident, rhythmic like reading a short checklist, a tiny beat between each step.

text: Cool. Who does that while I'm at the pool?
style: Skeptical and lazy, a casual challenge.

text: Me. Plug me into ManyChat. I build that script from your offer and adapt it to every lead.
style: Smooth and sly, a beat after 'Me', then an easy, confident offer.

text: It sounds like you. Minus the caps lock.
style: Dry and smug, a small beat before the joke.

text: Okay. How do I set you up?
style: Hesitant and a bit sheepish, a small pause after okay.

text: Close the laptop. You rented a fucking villa to copy-paste a PDF.
style: Mocking, laughing at him, slow and smug.

text: Comment SETTY and I'll send you everything to build your AI setter for free.
style: Smooth and smug, then warm and generous on the offer, like handing over a gift.
